title: basemap.de Web Vektor – feature classes (attribute klasse)
publisher: Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie (BKG) and the surveying authorities of the Länder (AdV Smart Mapping)
version: Style bm_web_col, basemap.de:style-version 5.0.3 (read 2026-09-30); vector tiles bm_web_de_3857 v2
license_note: Class strings are the exact 'klasse' values of the style filters. Colours are the fill (or line) colours of the colour style bm_web_col; data © basemap.de / BKG, Datenquellen © GeoBasis-DE.
note: Match the German klasse string of the vector tiles. No klasse in the research changes meaning between source layers, so no entry needs source_layer. Where the style ramps colours with zoom, the high-zoom value is given and the ramp is in the entry note. Buildings (source-layer Gebaeudeflaeche) are styled by layer, not by klasse, and are not listed.
